description: TU Delft provides UAV recordings of induced submerged slope failures at Site-C. A suction dredger undercut the slope toe during flowslide monitoring. The source identifies the slides in Chapter 6.5 and the UAV in Chapter 6.2.3 of the associated sand-slope thesis. Coverage: The test-site location is unstated.; 21/08/2019. Format: tif. Access: public native descriptive metadata. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The TIF descriptor does not establish georeferencing or an orthomosaic. Spatial resolution, flight settings and camera calibration are unstated. The source-defined parent collection concerns breaching flowslides during mining activities. Simulation use is interpreted as mining slope-hazard and geotechnical calibration evidence; no independent model validation is asserted. Related resources in the native collection have separate identities.
